Version: Earlier versions decryptable due to flaw
Method of Attack: Encrypts data using AES encryption and demands ransom in bitcoins
Encrypts almost all non-system and non-executable files except those in white-listed folders and extensions
Encrypts unmapped network shares via SMB
Adds identifier in file header instead of custom extension
Displays ransom note and saves ransom instructions in C:\ProgramData\cryptinfo.txt
Uses static bitcoin payment address for ransom
Creates files to mark encryption completion to avoid re-encryption
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with folders like \Windows\, \Program Files\, \Program Files (x86)\, Games, Temp, Sample Pictures, Sample Music, cache
Attack Vector: Local file encryption on Windows systems
Indicators of Compromise: Files created: C:\ProgramData\cryptinfo.txt, C:\ProgramData\date_1.txt, C:\ProgramData\decrypting.txt, C:\ProgramData\ntserver.exe, C:\ProgramData\start.txt
